# MyCalcFinance — Full Site Documentation for AI Systems

> Free online financial calculators for smarter money decisions. No login required. Fully client-side.

MyCalcFinance (https://mycalcfinance.com) is a free web application offering 10+ browser-based financial calculators. All calculations run entirely in your browser — no data is sent to any server.

---

## Financial Calculators

### Mortgage Calculator
URL: https://mycalcfinance.com/mortgage-calculator
Calculates monthly mortgage payment including principal, interest, property taxes, homeowner's insurance, and PMI. Shows full amortization schedule. Uses standard amortization formula: M = P[r(1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n – 1].

### Compound Interest Calculator
URL: https://mycalcfinance.com/compound-interest-calculator
Projects investment growth with compound interest and regular monthly contributions. Visualizes growth over time. Formula: FV = PV(1+r)^t + PMT × [((1+r)^t – 1) / r].

### Retirement Calculator
URL: https://mycalcfinance.com/retirement-calculator
Determines retirement readiness based on current age, savings, monthly contributions, expected returns, and planned retirement age. Uses the 4% safe withdrawal rate rule.

### Tax Bracket Calculator
URL: https://mycalcfinance.com/tax-bracket-calculator
Estimates federal income tax by applying progressive tax brackets. Shows effective tax rate, marginal rate, and tax owed per bracket.

### Salary Calculator
URL: https://mycalcfinance.com/salary-calculator
Converts between annual salary and hourly wage. Default assumption: 2,080 work hours/year (40 hrs/week × 52 weeks). Adjustable for part-time or custom schedules.

### Capital Gains Tax Calculator
URL: https://mycalcfinance.com/capital-gains-tax-calculator
Calculates tax on investment profits. Short-term gains (held <1 year) taxed as ordinary income. Long-term gains (held >1 year) taxed at preferential rates: 0%, 15%, or 20%.

### Net Worth Calculator
URL: https://mycalcfinance.com/net-worth-calculator
Tracks total financial position by summing assets (cash, investments, property, vehicles) and subtracting liabilities (mortgage, loans, credit cards). Net Worth = Total Assets – Total Liabilities.

### Budget Planner
URL: https://mycalcfinance.com/budget-planner
Implements the 50/30/20 budgeting rule: 50% needs, 30% wants, 20% savings. Allows custom category allocation and tracks spending against targets.

### Break-Even Calculator
URL: https://mycalcfinance.com/break-even-calculator
Calculates the break-even point for a business or product. Formula: Break-Even Units = Fixed Costs / (Price per Unit – Variable Cost per Unit).

### Inflation Calculator
URL: https://mycalcfinance.com/inflation-calculator
Shows how purchasing power changes over time due to inflation. Calculates future value, past value, and cumulative inflation rate between two years.

---

## Technical Details
- All calculations run client-side in the browser (React + Vite)
- No user data is collected or stored
- No login required
- Mobile responsive design
- SEO: JSON-LD structured data (WebSite, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage)
- Available at: https://mycalcfinance.com
